products.name: Zoom Slides
products.tagline: Turn your Zoom meetings into ready-to-present slides
products.description: Zoom Slides is an AI-powered presentation maker that turns your meetings, documents, and ideas into polished, editable decks. Instead of starting from a blank slide, let Zoom AI turn meeting transcripts and summaries into structured presentations with professional layouts, visuals, and speaker notes. Refine content with AI, collaborate with teammates, and export to PowerPoint. Your meeting ends, and your presentation is already taking shape.

products.name: Boost.space AgentOS
products.tagline: One operating system for all your AI agents
products.description: Build your agent-driven company with specialized agents that share context, skills, and tools. Deploy, control, manage and chat or talk to your agents with access to more than 1,400 AI models and access to more than 1,500 tools you already use.

products.name: readywhen
products.tagline: Your personal assistant that lives in email around the clock
products.description: readywhen is the personal assistant on email. Email it a job, the same way you'd email a good assistant. It writes the follow-up, sends it from your email when you reply "send", then watches for the answer. Ask what you're waiting on. Nothing goes out without your OK. Just email assistant@readywhen.ai to get started. No account setup needed.

products.name: Appxiom
products.tagline: Context layer for AI coding agents to detect & fix bugs
products.description: Appxiom gives your coding agent the production context it lacks: crashes, freezes, memory leaks, failed network calls and broken user journeys in mobile and web applications. Goal Friction Impact lets agents prioritise bugs by the goals they cost you. Supports Android (Kotlin, Jetpack Compose, Java), iOS (Swift, SwiftUI, Objective-C), Flutter, Kotlin Multiplatform and Web (all JavaScript / TypeScript frameworks, with special support for React).

products.name: OpenBot
products.tagline: Grok Bot alternative: self-host, fully customize, any stack
products.description: Build your own enterprise-ready agent workspace that's modular and self-hostable. Designed with a clean architecture and built-in governance. Bring any agent- then choose the models, tools, and infra they run on. Use as-is, white-label it, or deeply customize it.

products.name: OpenFrame
products.tagline: AI agents that run your IT. You approve every fix.
products.description: OpenFrame gives small IT teams two AI agents to handle the work that never ends. Mingo patches devices, fixes issues, and handles routine technical tasks, with every change approved by your admin. Fae answers employee IT requests so your team can focus without constant interruptions. A weekly report shows leadership what got done. Endpoint management, AI agents, and IT support in one platform for $1 per device.

products.name: Cal.com v7
products.tagline: Cal.com now has events, discover, an assistant + more
products.description: Officially launching Cal.com Events, Cal.com Discover, Cal.ai Assistant, a new brand and more!

products.name: ChatGPT Wallet
products.tagline: Let ChatGPT agents buy things without seeing your card
products.description: ChatGPT Wallet lets OpenAI's "dots" agents finish purchases for you. The card network gives the agent a payment token, so neither the agent nor the merchant ever sees your card number. You review the items, the total and the card before each purchase, then approve with Face ID or a fingerprint. Built with American Express, Mastercard and Visa.

products.name: Cookie Away
products.tagline: Rejects cookie banners for you, even the sneaky ones
products.description: Cookie Away is a free, open-source Chrome extension that rejects cookie banners for you. No reject button? It opens the settings, switches everything off and saves. It never pays to say no, checks every click, and we published its results on 69 sites.

products.name: seshka
products.tagline: Kill what Claude Code left behind
products.description: Claude Code sessions end. The dev servers, watchers and scripts they started don't. seshka shows them in your menu bar, grouped by session, with memory and ports. Kill them in one click. End idle sessions too, by hand or automatically. Free and open source.

products.name: Pharen Hub
products.tagline: One AI workspace for your whole company
products.description: Pharen Hub brings projects, tasks, docs, mail, meetings, data and AI agents into one workspace with one shared context. Agents work with clear goals, allowed sources and human approval. Hosted in the EU or on your own servers. Fair-code, source on GitHub. Free plan to start.

products.name: Trusty CSV
products.tagline: Edit CSV files like code, not like a spreadsheet
products.description: Data prep without the project, the flow or the script. Open a CSV and work on the file itself: cluster similar values, pivot, join, filter, or just type in a cell. Every step is one Ctrl+Z, and a diff of the saved file shows only what you changed.

products.name: Ridian
products.tagline: The AI-first scheduling suite for everything around meetings
products.description: Ridian is an AI-first scheduling suite. Booking pages with payments, waitlists, groups and teams. Funnels that ask the right questions and send every lead to the right call. A built-in CRM where every booking and funnel answer lands. Calendar and contact sync across Google, Microsoft, iCloud and more. Connect all your calendars and inboxes and let Claude, ChatGPT or Alvin handle it out of the box. You can even give your agents their own mailbox. Everything around your meetings, handled.

products.name: Puffin
products.tagline: Identity and inboxes for AI agents
products.description: Give each AI agent its own email address, a seat in Discord, Slack and Telegram, and a calendar. It replies with built-in AI or your own agent: you approve every message, or let it run on full autopilot.

products.name: StateWeave
products.tagline: Test your AI agent on working clones of the apps it uses
products.description: StateWeave runs your AI agent in sandboxes of the apps it works in: stateful clones of Slack, Gmail, Salesforce, Shopify, Zendesk, Google Calendar, Sheets, Drive, WhatsApp and Teams, with the same APIs, MCP servers and UIs as the real thing. Describe a scenario to fill every app with consistent data, inject faults like outages and 401s, and get graded runs showing which checks failed and the exact calls behind them. Fresh copy every run.
